title: Ibne Zehra ya Abbas
body:
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws...*2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ibne zehra ya Abbas asws..*2.
<<MINI>>
Assalamu alaika ya yabna ameeral momineen asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalamu alaika ya sayyadul mursaleen.
Assalamu alaika ya afzalush - shohada.
<<MINI>>
Assalamu alaika ya yabna ameeral momineen asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ibne zehra ya Abbas asws... ibne zehra ya Abbas asws... yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
1. Sher e quda asws. ne apne quda jjh. se tujhko dua mein maanga hain.
Apna beta kehke tujhko zehra s.a. ne bhi pukara hain.
Rab tu wafa ka...ya Abbas asws.
Sabr ki duniya.... ya Abbas asws...
<<MINI>>
Ya abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab aayenge moula mehdi ajtf. saara jahan yeh dekhega.
Tera pharera qaana e kaaba ke chat par lehraayega.
Lagega naara... ya Abbas asws.
Kahegi duniya... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Ya abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sahma sahma hai ab bhi darya ka kanara ay ghazi asws.
Tere qadam ko choom na paya isliye pyasa hain pani.
Pyaas ka dariya...ya Abbas asws.
Tujh se hain zinda... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Ya abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pyasi Sakina s.a. ke lab par hai naam tumhara har lamha.
Chod gaye ho tum jabse dushwaar hua hai yeh jeena.
Aao qudaaara... ya Abbas asws.
Ban ke sahara... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tere shaano'n ke tha bharose saniye zehra s.a. ka parda.
Laash pa tere thaame kamar ko aay Sarwar asws. waawaila.
Qoo'n mein bhara tha... ya Abbas asws.
Tera sarapa... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haath kate jis waqt tere qaimo'n se sada yeh aati thi.
Haaye aqi Abbas asws. mere Zainab asws. rokar farmati thi.
Mera parda... ya Abbas asws.
Cheenenge aada l.a....ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Teer laga tha aankh mein teri aur ek aankh mein qoo'n tha bhara.
Ab tak zehra s.a. roti hain ghode se tha tu aise giraa.
Sar tha bureeda...ya Abbas asws. aur tha pyasa... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Waqte aaqir ghazi asws. se moula ne kaha yeh ro ro kar.
Bhaayi mujhko bhaayi kehdo meri tamanna hain aaqir.
Bhayi pukara....ya Abbas asws.
Chodke duniya... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Naam se chote shahzade ke zinda hain yeh anjuman.
Ashk e aza se tar rehte hain inke sada ajmal daaman.
Apna rouza...ya Abbas asws.
Inko dikhana... ya Abbas asws.
<<MINI>>
Yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ibne zehra s.a. ya Abbas asws. ibne zehra s.a. ya Abbas asws. yaa abul fazlil Abbas asws.
Kalaam: janab mir jaffer Ali sahab(ajmal)
